title: Generate Parentheses
prompt: Given n pairs of parentheses, write a function to generate all combinations of well-formed parentheses.
hints: Backtracking. Track open count and close count. Add '(' when open < n. Add ')' when close < open.
Base case: when open == n and close == n, we have a valid string. Add to result.
Recursively try adding '(' then backtrack, then try ')' then backtrack.
Each valid string has n open and n close, and at any prefix we have open >= close.
